data.name: Death's Touch
data.description: You can cause terrible wounds to appear on a creature with a melee touch attack. This attack deals 1d6+%1 points of negative energy damage. If used against an undead creature, it heals damage and grants a +2 channel resistance for 1 minute. You can use this ability a %2 times per day.|OracleDeathTouchDamageBonus|OracleDeathTouchTimes
